Yami Gautam wins National Award for 'Article 370'

Actress Yami Gautam won her first National Film Award for her role in the political thriller 'Article 370'. The film itself received the award for Best Feature Film at the 72nd National Film Awards ceremony held in Ekta Nagar, Gujarat. The film's director is Aditya Suhas Jambhale. Gautam shared a message for aspiring actors stating that success 'will happen for sure'.
